The Hebrew says “in the morning” without a separate “next.” The land is passively filled with water.
The Hebrew describes those girding on a belt and upward; BSB says all who could bear arms, young and old.
The Hebrew says Moab saw the water red as blood; BSB describes how it looked to them.
The Hebrew describes the kings as destroyed, using a passive verb, and then says each struck his neighbor; BSB describes clashing swords and slaughtering one another.
